name: DropLeads
summary: Prime-DB people and company search, verified or simple person enrichment, company enrichment and credit balance.

api_key.description: a DropLeads API key (Settings > API Keys in your DropLeads account; shown once)

notes: Credits: searching people and counting are free and return masked data (no email or phone); verified enrich 0.2 credits per verified lead; simple enrich (no verification) 0.2 per lead; company search 0.1 per company returned; company enrich 0.1 per company found.
Typical flow: lead search or count with filters, check the cost with dropleads.leads.export_cost, then enrich chosen lead ids with dropleads.leads.enrich (verified) or dropleads.leads.simple_enrich.
Bodies are JSON with a filters object (combined with AND) and, for searches, a pagination object {page, limit}. Most array filters have a parallel *Exclude key.
The standalone email finder, email verifier and mobile finder (POST /email-finder, /email-verifier, /mobile-finder) live on a different host, api.dropleads.io, and are not in this entry.
This reference host also accepts 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' in place of X-API-Key.

endpoints.name: Search people
endpoints.summary: Contacts matching filters; masked, with no email or phone revealed.

filters.description: Filters combined with AND, all optional: jobTitles, jobTitlesExclude, jobTitlesSimilar, industries, keywords, technologies, departments, seniority, companyNames, companyDomains, linkedinUrls, employeeRanges, customEmployeeRange {min,max}, revenueRange {min,max}, fundingRange {min,max}, foundedYear {min,max}, countries, states, cities, locationScope (personal, company or both), personalCountries/organizationCountries {include,exclude} (and States, Cities, Regions), lists, companyLists, segments, buyingIntent, requireEmail; most have an *Exclude twin.

notes: A read over POST. Free. Use a returned lead id with the enrich calls to reveal contact details.

endpoints.name: Count matching people
endpoints.summary: The number of contacts matching the filters.

count.description: Number of leads intended to save or export.

leadIds.description: Explicit lead ids, instead of count.

filters.description: Filters combined with AND, all optional: jobTitles, jobTitlesExclude, jobTitlesSimilar, industries, keywords, technologies, departments, seniority, companyNames, companyDomains, linkedinUrls, employeeRanges, customEmployeeRange {min,max}, revenueRange {min,max}, fundingRange {min,max}, foundedYear {min,max}, countries, states, cities, locationScope (personal, company or both), personalCountries/organizationCountries {include,exclude} (and States, Cities, Regions), lists, companyLists, segments, buyingIntent, requireEmail; most have an *Exclude twin.

endpoints.name: Enrich one person with verification
endpoints.summary: Runs email verification and returns the record only if the email is verified.

id.description: Lead id from search results; skips matching and looks the lead up directly.

name.description: Full name, instead of first_name and last_name.

email_verification_type.description: valid_only, or valid_and_catchall to also accept catch-all addresses.

notes: A read over POST. 0.2 credits per verified lead. Needs at least one identifier: id, linkedin_url alone, email + organization, or name + organization/domain.

endpoints.name: Enrich up to 10 people with verification
endpoints.summary: Each person is verified individually; only verified matches are returned.

details.description: Up to 10 person objects, each with id, or linkedin_url, or email + organization_name, or name + organization_name/domain.

email_verification_type.description: valid_only, or valid_and_catchall to also accept catch-all addresses.

notes: A read over POST. 0.2 credits per verified lead. Synchronous, not a background job.

endpoints.name: Enrich one person without verification
endpoints.summary: Returns the match directly, with no email verification.

id.description: Lead id from search results; skips matching and looks the lead up directly.

name.description: Full name, instead of first_name and last_name.

notes: A read over POST. 0.2 credits per lead. The email may be unverified.

endpoints.name: Enrich up to 10 people without verification

details.description: Up to 10 person objects, each with id, or linkedin_url, or email + organization_name, or name + organization_name/domain.

notes: A read over POST. 0.2 credits per lead. Synchronous, not a background job.

endpoints.name: Search companies

filters.description: Filters combined with AND, all optional: companyNames, companyDomains, linkedinUrls, industries, industriesExclude, keywords, keywordsExclude, technologies, technologiesExclude, employeeRanges, customEmployeeRange {min,max}, revenueRange {min,max}, fundingRange {min,max}, foundedYear {min,max}, countries/states/cities/regions {include,exclude}, lists {type, listIds}.

notes: A read over POST. 0.1 credit per company returned on the page.
